_about: The words of the how-it-works figure (assets/src/how.ts): one lane for each command, from what you ask, through the agent that does it in its own context, to what comes back. A *starred* phrase is drawn in the accent.
title: How it works
lead: Three commands. Each hands your question to one of nxk's agents, which works in its own context and hands back only its result.
columns: nxk's agent, in its own context

lanes.ask: Who would want it, how many, where, and which version
lanes.back: *Findings:* strong leads first, each sized and broken down, and the groups nothing serves

lanes.ask: A page, a policy, a letter or a plan
lanes.back: *At most three points,* each with who and how many, or one line saying none

lanes.ask: A group of people, and your page if you like
lanes.back: *The group counted,* and a few of its people as cards, walked through your page if you ask

check: Before anything reaches you, every figure is checked against the record of the tool that printed it.

legend.text: *Counts* on 200,000 made-up adults a country: on your computer, free, in seconds.
*Scans* with a decision model: on your own key, about 2 US cents a version.

note: Until you ask, nxk's tools are not loaded, and Claude works as it would without nxk.
